description.value: A community hub operated by the Ukrainian-Canadian Cultural Society of Vancouver Island, dedicated to preserving and celebrating Ukrainian-Canadian heritage on Vancouver Island. The centre hosts cultural events, Ukrainian supper nights with homemade perogies and cabbage rolls, a Ukrainian library, gift shop, dance programs, and choirs. Located on Douglas Street in Victoria, it doubles as a licensed event venue with a spacious hall, stage, and kitchen facilities.

judgement.verdict_reason: Public cultural programming and shop, not members-only.

Café or food on site.detail: Ukrainian suppers with homemade perogies, cabbage rolls, and sausage served at scheduled community events; catering services also available; prominent 'BUY UKRAINIAN FOOD' option on website

wow_evidence: Cultural society hub with public perogy supper nights, gift shop, library — event-conditional but genuinely open public programming.
blurb: Ukrainian cultural hub on Douglas Street; public perogy suppers and gift shop.
